responsibility: Declares the Rust HIR pattern type-checking visitor. TypeCheckPattern exposes the entry point for checking a pattern against an expected TyTy parent type and provides visit hooks for the supported pattern forms, separate from expression and item resolution.
same_name_distinction: Declares the TypeCheckPattern visitor, its Resolve entry point, and supported pattern-form visit hooks for checking against an expected parent type. The corresponding rust-hir-type-check-pattern.cc provides the actual validation and type-propagation logic.
